messages:
maya: SLA alert for embeddings — sudden 5xx spike, hitting 99.90% instead of our 99.95 SLO. Looks like KV-cache eviction regression in 1.3.2 under high prefix churn. I have a candidate quickpatch image 1.3.3 that pins eviction window. Change window ends in 25m, can we fast-track? @sre-oncall @nina @liam

sre-oncall: Can we get rollback criteria and a short verification plan? If there's a clear rollback trigger I'll approve expedited.

nina: Need a quick smoke + perf check. Can you paste the test command and the image sha? Also confirm no schema changes.

liam: Build is green on CI. Image: `redwood/emb:1.3.3-rc2` sha=`abc1234f`. No schema changes. Quick smoke I ran: `kubectl exec -it load-test -- curl -sS http://embeddings-svc/health` and a small qps run: `python tests/load_smoke.py --qps 50 --duration 60` — passed locally.

maya: Pasted the smoke results in thread, looks ok. Proposed steps: 1) start 5% canary, 2) watch 2m for error rate / latency regressions, 3) promote to 50% then full swap if clean. Will pin the image until end of day.

ops-bot: Expedited approval requested by maya. Please react with :thumbsup: from 3 eng leads within 10m to proceed.

cara: :thumbsup:

liam: :thumbsup:

ethan: Posting short release note to changelog now — will link PR.

nina: I approve if we have an automatic rollback trigger: if 5xx > 0.5% above baseline for 2 consecutive minutes OR p95 latency increases > 200ms, auto-rollback. I'll monitor.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary start command accepted: `/deploy start --service=embeddings --image=redwood/emb:1.3.3-rc2 --canary=5% --notes="hotfix kv-cache eviction"`

deploy-bot: Canary deployed to 8 instances (5% traffic). Metrics: errors 0.02% (baseline 0.03%), p95 latency -5ms vs baseline. Link: https://deploy.metrics/canary/7128001234

maya: Good so far. Kicking promote to 50% in 3m if metrics hold.

deploy-bot: Promoting canary to 50% traffic...

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Promotion complete. 50% traffic on `redwood/emb:1.3.3-rc2`. Metrics steady.

deploy-bot: Full swap initiated: `/deploy promote --to=redwood/emb:1.3.3-rc2 --traffic=100%`

deploy-bot: Swap complete — production now running image `redwood/emb:1.3.3-rc2`. Rollback command available: `/deploy rollback --to=redwood/emb:1.3.2 --ticket=HOTFIX-7128`

eathan: Changelog PR: https://git.host/changelog/pull/452 — short note: "Fix kv-cache eviction causing transient 5xx under prefix churn. Backported to 1.3.x."

sre-oncall: Observability looks green after swap. No regression signals. Approving hotfix and closing the expedited window. Please follow up with postmortem if this repeats.

maya: Thanks all — will add a short follow-up in #postmortems if we need deeper RCA.

cara: Nice work everyone :tada:
